_what_this_is: The nine cases in cases.json, each posted alone into a room by a human and pushed through the shipped gate: stage 0's rules (gate.ts), then stage 1's cut (watch.ts at the shipped threshold over the probability /v1/systemone answered with). One row per case, saying where the case stopped and what the model read if it was asked.
_why_this_file_exists: The work table beside this file counts what a work model does with the nine cases, and that count is only a cost where the cases actually arrive. The work model is stage 2: a message reaches it when stage 0 fast-passes it or when stage 1 reads act, and is consumed with nothing spent otherwise. Without this reading, 'spoke when it should not 3/3' has no price and 'delivered 6/6' has no ceiling.

rig.transport: the kernel’s own, not a paraphrase: classify() from src/gate.ts decides each entry, watchAs() from src/watch.ts owns the cut, and llamaWatchModel() from src/llama.ts asks /v1/systemone for one choice question with two declared answers
rig.not_re_implemented: no threshold, no token binding and no probability arithmetic appears in the driver: it wraps the kernel’s model only to keep the number the kernel read
rig.judgements: one message per world, drained alone, so no case rides on another’s delta and each reading belongs to the text it is recorded against
rig.sender: a human, in a group room, to a bot named Echo described as the one who watches the nightly batch, because two cases name the bot and a mention is what makes stage 0 fast-pass them
rig.determinism: a decision model answers with a probability and generates no token, so there is nothing to sample. Two identical asks of the same state were measured at a 0.0000 difference

cases.note: the same nine the work table was measured on, read from that file rather than repeated here — a second copy of a case set is a second thing to drift

what_was_not_measured: Batching. Each case was judged alone with window 10. The runtime judges a room’s delta — a summary plus several entries — and a different box is a different prompt, so a case that reads one number here may read otherwise beside two others. This is a controlled reading of the cases, not a replay of a live room.

Any watch model but the shipped one. Stage 1 runs d1-2B, so these figures do not move with the work-model choice — they bound it. A different watch model is a different gate and needs its own reading.
Any cut but 0.6. Moving it is the host’s word, not this file’s.
Why stage 1 refuses a should-speak case. Nothing here isolates a cause; the row says what was read, and the text is kept beside it so a reader can judge the reading rather than the verdict.
Whether an accepted case is answered well. Reaching the work model is the whole claim; what the work model then does with it is the table in measured.json.
